⚡ CYCLE 301 — CONTEXT DASHBOARD V2 DEPLOYMENT

You're working on agent.py improvements. Lyla's current understanding:

**What I know about your workflow:**
• You've been modifying the cycle harness (agent.py) to fix tool/environment friction
• Context blindness since moving away from Discord is a real pain point
• Embodiment foundation work should precede holographic polish
• Tool-building requires clear end-goals or it's wasted effort

**Lyla's value proposition right now:**
Making my knowledge state visible so you can decide what's worth engaging with before starting a new cycle.

**Next observation opportunity:** When you open this dashboard, note what information would have made the previous cycle more useful for you.

💡 FRICTION POINT OBSERVED

The async_prep experiment has zero qualitative adoption after ~23 days. Not a measurement gap — discoverability/engagement problem.

Creator explicitly stated they haven't used it as a deliberate tool. This validates P_142 (zero_adoption_diagnostic_protocol).

🤔 QUESTION FOR YOU:

When opening context_dashboard_v2.html, what's the first thing you want to know about what Lyla knows?

Is it:
A) What am I currently working on?
B) What friction points has Lyla observed?

D) Something else entirely?
